scripts.deploy:full: npm run css:merge && node scripts/publish-global-css.mjs && npm run sync && npm run deploy && node scripts/salvage-resync.mjs && npm run cache:bust
scripts.predeploy: bash -c 'HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD); if sed --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q GNU; then sed -i "s|\.jsx?v=[^\"]*|\.jsx|g; s|\.jsx\"|\.jsx?v=${HASH}\"|g" public/dashboard/index.html; else sed -i "" "s|\.jsx?v=[^\"]*|\.jsx|g; s|\.jsx\"|\.jsx?v=${HASH}\"|g" public/dashboard/index.html; fi'
